hypothesis: When a client re-anchors a session using a recovery key belonging to a different user, the backend generates and transmits the victim's access_token (JWT) over the wire before the client can reject it. Furthermore, differentiating error messages provides an oracle confirming the existence of active accounts.

Displaying '此引繼碼屬於另一個帳號' leaks user enumeration intelligence. Additionally, lacking a post-restoration grace window allows in-flight stale 401s to re-trigger the re-auth modal immediately after successful re-anchoring.
